_doc: Saber lab scenarios (docs/gameplay/SABER_LAB.md). 'lab' keys go to `saberlab start`; 'cvars' are set on the world before the map loads. Fighter a stands at the anchor facing b; b stands `dist` away facing a.

dummy_medium.about: Medium-stance single click (150 ms attack) standing still, against a holstered target: damage per swing.

dummy_strong.about: Strong-stance single click against a holstered target.

dummy_fast.about: Fast-stance attack held 600 ms (a chain) against a holstered target.

block_medium.about: Medium click into an idle defender (defense 3). With SP-style damage (d_saberSPStyleDamage 1, the default) an idle saber blocks only by physical contact; there is no automatic block roll, so this measures how often the idle blade is in the way (2026-10-21: never, at this geometry).

clash_medium.about: Both medium, both click at the same moment: saber-vs-saber outcomes.

clash_strong_fast.about: Strong into fast, both clicking, fast 60 ms later.

lock_mash.about: Forced saber lock (g_debugSaberLocks 1) after a medium clash; a mashes 12 Hz, b 6 Hz. Lock length and who takes the hit.
